paper.title: BindGPT: A Scalable Framework for 3D Molecular Design via Language Modeling and Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: BindGPT 是一个将 3D 分子设计表述为文本生成的语言模型框架，用 SMILES 加 XYZ 的文本格式同时描述分子图与原子坐标，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S1.p5][S3.SS1.p2]。作者在大规模 3D 分子与蛋白口袋数据上预训练，再在 CrossDocked 与 GEOM-DRUGS 上监督微调，并用外部对接软件打分做强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。实验表明该模型在 3D 分子生成、构象生成和口袋条件生成任务上可匹配或超过专门的扩散模型、语言模型和图神经网络，且采样成本低约两个数量级 [S4.SS1.p3][S4.SS2.p3][S5.p1]。作者认为这显示大规模预训练范式可以从 NLP 有效迁移到 3D 药物发现 [S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是如何用语言模型统一处理 3D 分子设计任务，包括 3D 分子生成、给定分子图的构象生成以及口袋条件分子生成 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。作者指出，多数空间分子生成器只关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等外部工具重建化学键，而原子位置的微小偏差可能显著改变重建的分子图甚至使其断裂 [S1.p2]。作者还指出，3D 分子生成在语言模型方法中受到的关注有限 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: This proficiency is demonstrated through successful applications in downstream tasks, including learning the distribution of 3D molecules, generating 3D conformations and the generation of molecules with targeted binding affinity to specific proteins.
We propose scalable pretraining-finetuning method for drug discovery in 3D that covers several 3D molecular generation tasks in a single paradigm.
They depend on supplementary tools, such as OpenBabel, for the critical task of bond reconstruction.

This reliance can introduce vulnerabilities, as the precision required for atom placement means that minor positional adjustments can significantly alter reconstructed molecular bonds or even make the molecular graph disconnected.
However, the challenge of 3D molecule generation has received limited attention in language model approach.

method.text: BindGPT 的核心思想是用自回归 token 生成模型把多种 3D 小分子生成任务统一表述为带提示的文本生成，将条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前 [S3.p1]。模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构并使用旋转位置嵌入以支持长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。文本表示把 XYZ 格式与 SMILES 格式耦合，强制两者原子顺序一致，并去掉 XYZ 中的原子符号，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S3.SS1.p2]。训练流程包括在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练、在 CrossDocked 与 GEOM-DRUGS 上监督微调，以及用外部对接软件奖励做 REINFORCE 强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: The key idea of our method is utilizing an autoregressive token generation model, influenced by GPT-based models, to solve several 3D small molecule generation tasks in one simple yet flexible paradigm.
To achieve that, we layout the tokens of a condition before the tokens of the object to generate.
In our work we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX
architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings. This technique allows for the length generalization
To alleviate that, we propose to couple the XYZ format with the SMILES format.
To align these two formats we enforce to have the same atom ordering in both. We also remove the atom symbol from the XYZ representation
Thus, we use a large-scale but specialized dataset of 3D molecules and protein pockets.
During the supervised fine-tuning phase, we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020
We apply the REINFORCE algorithm for further model finetuning.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 12M 分子的 208M 个构象和 3.2M 个蛋白口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 上微调，作者过滤后得到约 27M 个口袋-配体对，覆盖 14k 分子与 3k 口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。3D 分子与构象生成任务还在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调，该数据集包含 300k 分子的 27M 个构象，并以 Platinum 数据集作为零样本构象生成的留出评估集 [S4.p2]。对比基线包括 EDM、MolDiff、XYZ-Transformer、Torsional Diffusion、Uni-Mol、TargetDiff 和 Pocket2Mol [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
Our filtration of the dataset has around 27M pocket-ligand pairs covering a cross product of 14k molecules with 3k pockets
We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
we also finetune the model on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset, with drug-like molecules having high-quality 3D molecular conformations.
This dataset contains 27M conformations for 300k molecules
Finally, we use the Platinum dataset as a hold-out evaluation dataset to test our model and baselines on zero-shot conformer generation.
EDM and MolDiff are task-specialized diffusion models for 3D molecule generation. XYZ-Transformer is another 3D molecular transformer
For conformer generation, we compare BindGPT with the current state-of-the-art methods, Torsional Diffusion and the Uni-Mol model.
we include the baselines such as 3D diffusion model (TargetDiff) and autoregressive Graph Neural Network (Pocket2Mol).

findings.text: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不含和含显式氢两种设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上取得当前最佳表现，但在药物相似性上未超过 MolDiff [S4.SS1.p3]。在 Platinum 零样本构象生成中，BindGPT 借助 RDKit 时可匹配 Torsional Diffusion，不借助时存在小差距，而 Uni-Mol 未能泛化到该数据集 [S4.SS1.p3]。在口袋条件生成中，经强化学习微调的 BindGPT-RL 在结合能上显著优于此前所有最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: First, the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
BindGPT is the first model capable of modeling hydrogen explicitly at such large scale.
BindGPT (being finetuned on this data) shows state-of-the-art performance scores for nearly all distributional evaluation metrics.
Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness
BindGPT, in contrast, is capable of matching the performance of TD when assisted by the RDKit tool and having a small gap when not.
Surprisingly, Uni-Mol fails to generalize to this new dataset (even assisted by RDKit)
the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
